units.id: mission:FW Zug Expansion: Assisted|name|18|0
units.english: Convoy to Zug
units.italian: Convoglio per Zug

units.id: mission:FW Zug Expansion: Assisted|description|19|0
units.english: Escort a convoy of freighters to <destination> for an important project. Expect pirate raids.
units.italian: Scorta un convoglio di mercantili fino a <destination> per un progetto importante. Aspettati incursioni di pirati.

units.id: mission:FW Zug Expansion: Assisted|While returning from a walk around the spaceport of <origin>, you see the quartermaster of the spaceport inspecting your ship. He notices your arrival and comes up to greet you.|29|0
units.english: While returning from a walk around the spaceport of <origin>, you see the quartermaster of the spaceport inspecting your ship. He notices your arrival and comes up to greet you.
units.italian: Mentre torni da una passeggiata per lo spazioporto di <origin>, vedi il quartiermastro dello spazioporto che ispeziona la tua nave. Si accorge del tuo arrivo e ti viene incontro a salutarti.

units.id: mission:FW Zug Expansion: Assisted|	"You're Captain <first> <last>, yes? We're looking for a good ship that can escort these freighters to <planet>." He points towards five Syndicate Freighters in Free Worlds colors on the landing pads opposite to your ship, some of which have considerable hull damage and are actively being repaired.|30|0
units.english: "You're Captain <first> <last>, yes? We're looking for a good ship that can escort these freighters to <planet>." He points towards five Syndicate Freighters in Free Worlds colors on the landing pads opposite to your ship, some of which have considerable hull damage and are actively being repaired.
units.italian: "Tu sei il capitano <first> <last>, giusto? Cerchiamo una buona nave che possa scortare questi mercantili fino a <planet>." Indica cinque mercantili del Sindacato con i colori delle Free Worlds sulle piazzole di fronte alla tua nave, alcuni dei quali hanno danni allo scafo considerevoli e sono in fase di riparazione.

units.id: mission:FW Zug Expansion: Assisted|	"Their last escort was just taken out by pirates, and we need someone who is experienced enough to fend off or evade them. You must have a reputation, since some of our militia captains recognized you. This is for quite a significant project on <planet>, so you will be paid <payment>."|31|0
units.english: "Their last escort was just taken out by pirates, and we need someone who is experienced enough to fend off or evade them. You must have a reputation, since some of our militia captains recognized you. This is for quite a significant project on <planet>, so you will be paid <payment>."
units.italian: "La loro ultima scorta è stata appena eliminata dai pirati, e ci serve qualcuno abbastanza esperto da respingerli o seminarli. Devi avere una certa reputazione, visto che alcuni dei nostri capitani della milizia ti hanno riconosciuto. È per un progetto piuttosto importante su <planet>, quindi ti pagheremo <payment>."

units.id: mission:FW Zug Expansion: Assisted|	"What is the project? It seems to be a big enterprise."|33|0
units.english: "What is the project? It seems to be a big enterprise."
units.italian: "Di che progetto si tratta? Sembra un'impresa grossa."

units.id: mission:FW Zug Expansion: Assisted|	"That's a fair few freighters. Should I be expecting any more pirates?"|34|0
units.english: "That's a fair few freighters. Should I be expecting any more pirates?"
units.italian: "Sono parecchi mercantili. Devo aspettarmi altri pirati?"

units.id: mission:FW Zug Expansion: Assisted|	"Sorry, I'm not planning on going that way."|36|0
units.english: "Sorry, I'm not planning on going that way."
units.italian: "Scusa, non ho in programma di andare da quelle parti."

units.id: mission:FW Zug Expansion: Assisted|	"The freighters are carrying construction materials and specialized shipbuilding equipment for a planned extension to Zug's New Port, which has been a long time coming. It would greatly help the Free Worlds' efforts. I suppose that is why there have been pirates trying to pounce on these ships; the equipment would be a rich prize for them."|38|0
units.english: "The freighters are carrying construction materials and specialized shipbuilding equipment for a planned extension to Zug's New Port, which has been a long time coming. It would greatly help the Free Worlds' efforts. I suppose that is why there have been pirates trying to pounce on these ships; the equipment would be a rich prize for them."
units.italian: "I mercantili trasportano materiali da costruzione e attrezzature specializzate per la cantieristica, per un ampliamento previsto del New Port di Zug, che si aspetta da tempo. Aiuterebbe molto gli sforzi delle Free Worlds. Immagino sia per questo che i pirati hanno cercato di saltare addosso a queste navi; l'equipaggiamento sarebbe un ricco bottino per loro."

units.id: mission:FW Zug Expansion: Assisted|	"Yes, I would expect more pirate contact, because the movement of so many freighters would be a tempting target for them, and moreover, they are carrying valuable equipment for warship manufacturing. I'd certainly recommend avoiding combat when possible. In these trying times, the loss of these ships would be... not ideal."|41|0
units.english: "Yes, I would expect more pirate contact, because the movement of so many freighters would be a tempting target for them, and moreover, they are carrying valuable equipment for warship manufacturing. I'd certainly recommend avoiding combat when possible. In these trying times, the loss of these ships would be... not ideal."
units.italian: "Sì, mi aspetterei altri contatti con i pirati, perché il movimento di tanti mercantili sarebbe un bersaglio tentante, e inoltre trasportano equipaggiamento prezioso per la costruzione di navi da guerra. Consiglierei certamente di evitare il combattimento quando possibile. In questi tempi difficili, la perdita di queste navi sarebbe... non ideale."

units.id: mission:FW Zug Expansion: Assisted|	"Well, will you help us escort these freighters?"|43|0
units.english: "Well, will you help us escort these freighters?"
units.italian: "Beh, ci aiuterai a scortare questi mercantili?"

units.id: mission:FW Zug Expansion: Assisted|	"Of course, I'll get these freighters to <planet> safely."|45|0
units.english: "Of course, I'll get these freighters to <planet> safely."
units.italian: "Certo, porterò questi mercantili su <planet> sani e salvi."

units.id: mission:FW Zug Expansion: Assisted|	"No, I won't be able to, sorry."|46|0
units.english: "No, I won't be able to, sorry."
units.italian: "No, non potrò, mi dispiace."

units.id: mission:FW Zug Expansion: Assisted|	"Wonderful! I expect that these ships will benefit the Free Worlds immensely." With that, he leaves you to meet with the captains of the freighters.|48|0
units.english: "Wonderful! I expect that these ships will benefit the Free Worlds immensely." With that, he leaves you to meet with the captains of the freighters.
units.italian: "Meraviglioso! Sono certo che queste navi gioveranno immensamente alle Free Worlds." Detto questo, ti lascia per andare a incontrare i capitani dei mercantili.

units.id: mission:FW Zug Expansion: Assisted|dialog|84|0
units.english: You have reached <planet>, but you left part of the convoy behind! Better depart and wait for them to arrive in this star system.
units.italian: Hai raggiunto <planet>, ma hai lasciato indietro una parte del convoglio! Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivino in questo sistema.

units.id: mission:FW Zug Expansion: Assisted|The five freighters have all arrived intact, and you are told to land them beside a large area of land set aside for Zug's long-awaited New Port expansion. Not long after, you are sent <payment> by Zug's port authority.|90|0
units.english: The five freighters have all arrived intact, and you are told to land them beside a large area of land set aside for Zug's long-awaited New Port expansion. Not long after, you are sent <payment> by Zug's port authority.
units.italian: I cinque mercantili sono arrivati tutti intatti, e ti dicono di farli atterrare accanto a una vasta area di terreno riservata all'ampliamento tanto atteso del New Port di Zug. Non molto dopo, ricevi <payment> dall'autorità portuale di Zug.

units.id: mission:FW Zug Expansion: Assisted|	It seems that bringing so many freighters was justified, because the expansion also includes a considerable extension to Southbound's shipbuilding facilities to make them capable of building heavy warships like Tarazed Falcons. However, by the looks of it, all this equipment would be more than enough to build a Navy Cruiser.|91|0
units.english: It seems that bringing so many freighters was justified, because the expansion also includes a considerable extension to Southbound's shipbuilding facilities to make them capable of building heavy warships like Tarazed Falcons. However, by the looks of it, all this equipment would be more than enough to build a Navy Cruiser.
units.italian: Sembra che portare tutti quei mercantili fosse giustificato, perché l'ampliamento comprende anche una notevole estensione dei cantieri Southbound, per renderli capaci di costruire navi da guerra pesanti come i Falcon di Tarazed. A quanto pare, però, tutto questo equipaggiamento sarebbe più che sufficiente per costruire un incrociatore della Marina.

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Harmony|As you land on <planet>, you recall that the monks who live here are involved in some sort of outreach to children serving as pirate crew members. They might have something to say about the best way to deal with the pirate threat. Do you want to visit them?|117|0
units.english: As you land on <planet>, you recall that the monks who live here are involved in some sort of outreach to children serving as pirate crew members. They might have something to say about the best way to deal with the pirate threat. Do you want to visit them?
units.italian: Mentre atterri su <planet>, ricordi che i monaci che vivono qui si occupano di una specie di opera di assistenza verso i bambini che fanno parte degli equipaggi pirata. Potrebbero avere qualcosa da dire sul modo migliore di affrontare la minaccia pirata. Vuoi andare a trovarli?

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Harmony|	(Yes.)|119|0
units.english: (Yes.)
units.italian: (Sì.)

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Harmony|	(No.)|120|0
units.english: (No.)
units.italian: (No.)

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Harmony|	It's a short walk to the monastery from the spaceport. When you arrive there, you run into a monk who is working in the garden. He glances up, and recognizes you. "Welcome back," he says. "You're Katya's friend, right? I'm David. I've forgotten your name."|122|0
units.english: It's a short walk to the monastery from the spaceport. When you arrive there, you run into a monk who is working in the garden. He glances up, and recognizes you. "Welcome back," he says. "You're Katya's friend, right? I'm David. I've forgotten your name."
units.italian: Dal monastero allo spazioporto è una breve passeggiata. Quando arrivi, ti imbatti in un monaco che lavora nell'orto. Alza lo sguardo e ti riconosce. "Bentornato," dice. "Sei l'amico di Katya, vero? Io sono David. Ho dimenticato il tuo nome."

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Harmony|	"<first>," you say.|123|0
units.english: "<first>," you say.
units.italian: "<first>," dici.

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Harmony|	He brushes some of the dirt off his hands and then shakes hands with you. "How are you doing?" he asks. "And how is Katya? And Ijs?" You explain to him that you are now an official member of the Free Worlds, and that Katya has been captured by the Republic. He is clearly shocked and saddened by the news. After pressing you for all the details, he asks, "And what about you? What brings you to Harmony?"|124|0
units.english: He brushes some of the dirt off his hands and then shakes hands with you. "How are you doing?" he asks. "And how is Katya? And Ijs?" You explain to him that you are now an official member of the Free Worlds, and that Katya has been captured by the Republic. He is clearly shocked and saddened by the news. After pressing you for all the details, he asks, "And what about you? What brings you to Harmony?"
units.italian: Si toglie un po' di terra dalle mani e poi ti stringe la mano. "Come stai?" chiede. "E come sta Katya? E Ijs?" Gli spieghi che ora sei un membro ufficiale delle Free Worlds, e che Katya è stata catturata dalla Repubblica. È chiaramente scosso e addolorato dalla notizia. Dopo averti incalzato per tutti i dettagli, chiede: "E tu? Che cosa ti porta su Harmony?"

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Harmony|	"The Free Worlds are hoping to eliminate piracy in this sector, and I was hoping for advice on what targets we should attack."|126|0
units.english: "The Free Worlds are hoping to eliminate piracy in this sector, and I was hoping for advice on what targets we should attack."
units.italian: "Le Free Worlds sperano di eliminare la pirateria in questo settore, e speravo in un consiglio su quali bersagli attaccare."

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Harmony|	"The Free Worlds are thinking of launching an attack on the pirates, but I've been thinking about what Brother Greg said about the pirate crews being just kids."|127|0
units.english: "The Free Worlds are thinking of launching an attack on the pirates, but I've been thinking about what Brother Greg said about the pirate crews being just kids."
units.italian: "Le Free Worlds stanno pensando di lanciare un attacco ai pirati, ma stavo riflettendo su quello che ha detto fratello Greg, sul fatto che gli equipaggi pirata sono solo ragazzini."

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Harmony|	"If you want some military advice," he says, "here's what I can tell you. You cannot create peace using violence. Most people on the pirate worlds are not pirates, just ordinary people unlucky enough to be born there. Or people who feel unwelcome everywhere else."|129|0
units.english: "If you want some military advice," he says, "here's what I can tell you. You cannot create peace using violence. Most people on the pirate worlds are not pirates, just ordinary people unlucky enough to be born there. Or people who feel unwelcome everywhere else."
units.italian: "Se vuoi un consiglio militare," dice, "ecco quello che posso dirti. Non si crea la pace con la violenza. La maggior parte della gente sui mondi pirata non è fatta di pirati, ma di persone comuni che hanno avuto la sfortuna di nascere lì. O di persone che si sentono indesiderate ovunque altrove."

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Harmony|	"It's true," he says. "If you fight the pirates, innocent lives will be lost."|132|0
units.english: "It's true," he says. "If you fight the pirates, innocent lives will be lost."
units.italian: "È vero," dice. "Se combatti i pirati, si perderanno vite innocenti."

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Harmony|	"Then what do you suggest we do?" you ask.|134|0
units.english: "Then what do you suggest we do?" you ask.
units.italian: "Allora che cosa suggerisci di fare?" chiedi.

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Harmony|	"Well," he says, "it's worth repeating that most people on the 'pirate' worlds are not pirates. They're just anarchists. As a monk, I feel a sort of kinship with them."|135|0
units.english: "Well," he says, "it's worth repeating that most people on the 'pirate' worlds are not pirates. They're just anarchists. As a monk, I feel a sort of kinship with them."
units.italian: "Beh," dice, "vale la pena ripetere che la maggior parte della gente sui mondi 'pirata' non è fatta di pirati. Sono solo anarchici. Come monaco, sento una specie di affinità con loro."

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Harmony|	"How so?"|137|0
units.english: "How so?"
units.italian: "In che senso?"

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Harmony|	"Naturally."|138|0
units.english: "Naturally."
units.italian: "Naturalmente."

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Harmony|	"For starters, we both wear black all the time," he says, grinning. "And more to the point, we're both seeking to build an alternative community according to our own ideals. Historically, monasticism can actually be seen as a form of utopic anarchism - 'Fear none but God' and all that."|140|0
units.english: "For starters, we both wear black all the time," he says, grinning. "And more to the point, we're both seeking to build an alternative community according to our own ideals. Historically, monasticism can actually be seen as a form of utopic anarchism - 'Fear none but God' and all that."
units.italian: "Tanto per cominciare, portiamo entrambi sempre il nero," dice, sorridendo. "E soprattutto, cerchiamo entrambi di costruire una comunità alternativa secondo i nostri ideali. Storicamente, il monachesimo si può persino vedere come una forma di anarchismo utopico: 'Non temere che Dio' e cose del genere."

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Harmony|	"Of course."|142|0
units.english: "Of course."
units.italian: "Certamente."

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Harmony|	"That makes absolutely no sense. Are you joking around with me?"|143|0
units.english: "That makes absolutely no sense. Are you joking around with me?"
units.italian: "Non ha assolutamente senso. Mi stai prendendo in giro?"

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Harmony|	He grins. "Well, that's a tangent, anyway. My real advice is this: figure out what the people on those pirate worlds want, and how to offer it to them. Freedom from government intervention would be a good start. But that means no annexing their territory for the Free Worlds. Instead, you could offer them some sort of pact: they stop supporting pirate fleets, and you agree to leave their planets in peace."|145|0
units.english: He grins. "Well, that's a tangent, anyway. My real advice is this: figure out what the people on those pirate worlds want, and how to offer it to them. Freedom from government intervention would be a good start. But that means no annexing their territory for the Free Worlds. Instead, you could offer them some sort of pact: they stop supporting pirate fleets, and you agree to leave their planets in peace."
units.italian: Sorride. "Beh, questa è comunque una digressione. Il mio vero consiglio è questo: scopri che cosa vogliono gli abitanti di quei mondi pirata, e come offrirlo loro. La libertà dall'interferenza del governo sarebbe un buon inizio. Ma questo significa non annettere il loro territorio alle Free Worlds. Invece potreste offrire loro una specie di patto: loro smettono di sostenere le flotte pirata, e voi accettate di lasciare in pace i loro pianeti."

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Harmony|	"Thanks for the advice. I'll see if we can work out something like that."|147|0
units.english: "Thanks for the advice. I'll see if we can work out something like that."
units.italian: "Grazie del consiglio. Vedrò se riusciamo a combinare qualcosa del genere."

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Harmony|	"No way. We need to speak the language they understand. Overwhelming force."|148|0
units.english: "No way. We need to speak the language they understand. Overwhelming force."
units.italian: "Niente affatto. Dobbiamo parlare la lingua che capiscono. La forza schiacciante."

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Harmony|	He wishes you the best of luck, and you return to the port.|150|0
units.english: He wishes you the best of luck, and you return to the port.
units.italian: Ti augura buona fortuna, e torni al porto.

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Harmony|	"It won't end," he says, "not unless you exterminate every last person on those planets. But I can't control what choices you make. Good luck." He returns to gardening, and you walk back to the spaceport.|153|0
units.english: "It won't end," he says, "not unless you exterminate every last person on those planets. But I can't control what choices you make. Good luck." He returns to gardening, and you walk back to the spaceport.
units.italian: "Non finirà," dice, "non finché non sterminerete ogni singola persona su quei pianeti. Ma non posso controllare le scelte che fate. Buona fortuna." Torna a occuparsi dell'orto, e tu torni a piedi allo spazioporto.

units.id: mission:FW Conservatory 1|name|159|0
units.english: Take Ijs to <planet>
units.italian: Porta Ijs su <planet>

units.id: mission:FW Conservatory 1|description|160|0
units.english: Transport Mr. Eyes and the Andersons to <destination>, where he will be helping to set up a public university.
units.italian: Trasporta Mr. Eyes e gli Anderson su <destination>, dove aiuterà a fondare un'università pubblica.

units.id: mission:FW Conservatory 1|blocked|164|0
units.english: You meet up with Ijs in the spaceport, but he tells you that you will need three bunks for him and some friends. Return here once you have space available.
units.italian: Incontri Ijs allo spazioporto, ma ti dice che ti serviranno tre cuccette per lui e alcuni amici. Torna qui quando avrai lo spazio disponibile.

units.id: mission:FW Conservatory 1|When you meet Ijs in the spaceport, he has Lynn and Henry Anderson with him, the friends of Katya who you transported from Glory back before you joined the Free Worlds. Ijs is beaming - his meeting must have gone really well. "Guess what, Captain?" he says. "We've got a location for the Conservatory! The government of Winter has offered a community center for our use."|175|0
units.english: When you meet Ijs in the spaceport, he has Lynn and Henry Anderson with him, the friends of Katya who you transported from Glory back before you joined the Free Worlds. Ijs is beaming - his meeting must have gone really well. "Guess what, Captain?" he says. "We've got a location for the Conservatory! The government of Winter has offered a community center for our use."
units.italian: Quando incontri Ijs allo spazioporto, ha con sé Lynn e Henry Anderson, gli amici di Katya che avevi trasportato da Glory prima di unirti alle Free Worlds. Ijs è raggiante: il suo incontro dev'essere andato davvero bene. "Indovina, Capitano?" dice. "Abbiamo una sede per il Conservatorio! Il governo di Winter ci ha offerto un centro civico."

units.id: mission:FW Conservatory 1|When you meet Ijs in the spaceport, he has a man and a woman with him which he introduces as Lynn and Henry Anderson, a top planetary scientist and ex-Navy intel officer who defected from the Republic shortly after the Free Worlds were formed. Ijs is beaming - his meeting must have gone really well. "Guess what, Captain?" he says. "We've got a location for the Conservatory! The government of Winter has offered a community center for our use."|179|0
units.english: When you meet Ijs in the spaceport, he has a man and a woman with him which he introduces as Lynn and Henry Anderson, a top planetary scientist and ex-Navy intel officer who defected from the Republic shortly after the Free Worlds were formed. Ijs is beaming - his meeting must have gone really well. "Guess what, Captain?" he says. "We've got a location for the Conservatory! The government of Winter has offered a community center for our use."
units.italian: Quando incontri Ijs allo spazioporto, ha con sé un uomo e una donna che ti presenta come Lynn e Henry Anderson, una scienziata planetaria di primo livello e un ex ufficiale dell'intelligence della Marina che disertò dalla Repubblica poco dopo la nascita delle Free Worlds. Ijs è raggiante: il suo incontro dev'essere andato davvero bene. "Indovina, Capitano?" dice. "Abbiamo una sede per il Conservatorio! Il governo di Winter ci ha offerto un centro civico."

units.id: mission:FW Conservatory 1|	"A somewhat run-down community center," adds Henry.|182|0
units.english: "A somewhat run-down community center," adds Henry.
units.italian: "Un centro civico un po' malandato," aggiunge Henry.

units.id: mission:FW Conservatory 1|	Ijs laughs. "True. Anyway, we were hoping you could give us a lift over there, and maybe help out with securing some equipment, too."|183|0
units.english: Ijs laughs. "True. Anyway, we were hoping you could give us a lift over there, and maybe help out with securing some equipment, too."
units.italian: Ijs ride. "Vero. Comunque, speravamo che potessi darci un passaggio fin lì, e magari aiutarci a recuperare un po' di attrezzatura."

units.id: mission:FW Conservatory 1|	"Sure, I'd definitely like to help make this a reality!"|185|0
units.english: "Sure, I'd definitely like to help make this a reality!"
units.italian: "Certo, mi piacerebbe molto aiutare a rendere tutto questo realtà!"

units.id: mission:FW Conservatory 1|	"Sorry, I've got more important business to attend to."|187|0
units.english: "Sorry, I've got more important business to attend to."
units.italian: "Scusa, ho faccende più importanti a cui badare."

units.id: mission:FW Conservatory 1|	Ijs seems really dejected. "Are you sure?" he asks. "This could make a big difference for the Free Worlds, as much as any military victory. We could just tag along with whatever 'more important business' you have until it's convenient for you to drop us off."|188|0
units.english: Ijs seems really dejected. "Are you sure?" he asks. "This could make a big difference for the Free Worlds, as much as any military victory. We could just tag along with whatever 'more important business' you have until it's convenient for you to drop us off."
units.italian: Ijs sembra davvero abbattuto. "Ne sei sicuro?" chiede. "Questo potrebbe fare una grande differenza per le Free Worlds, quanto qualsiasi vittoria militare. Potremmo semplicemente seguirvi in qualunque 'faccenda più importante' abbiate, finché non sarà comodo per te lasciarci lì."

units.id: mission:FW Conservatory 1|	"Okay, I'll help you."|190|0
units.english: "Okay, I'll help you."
units.italian: "Va bene, vi aiuto."

units.id: mission:FW Conservatory 1|	"Sorry, I'm just not interested."|192|0
units.english: "Sorry, I'm just not interested."
units.italian: "Scusa, non mi interessa."

units.id: mission:FW Conservatory 1|dialog|196|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but you realize that Mr. Eyes and the Andersons are on one of your escorts that hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it to arrive.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che Mr. Eyes e gli Anderson sono su una delle tue scorte che non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:FW Conservatory 1|dialog|199|0
units.english: Ijs thanks you for the lift and gives you a credit chip for <payment>. He says, "Next we need to pick up some equipment from Tarazed Corporation. Meet me in the spaceport if you're willing to help out as an escort."
units.italian: Ijs ti ringrazia per il passaggio e ti dà una scheda di credito da <payment>. Dice: "Ora dobbiamo recuperare un po' di attrezzatura dalla Tarazed Corporation. Ci vediamo allo spazioporto se sei disposto ad aiutarci come scorta."

units.id: mission:FW Conservatory 2|name|204|0
units.english: Escort to <planet>
units.italian: Scorta per <planet>

units.id: mission:FW Conservatory 2|description|205|0
units.english: Escort this Free Worlds convoy to <destination>, to trade for terraforming equipment provided by Tarazed and the Syndicate.
units.italian: Scorta questo convoglio delle Free Worlds fino a <destination>, per scambiare merci con l'equipaggiamento per la terraformazione fornito da Tarazed e dal Sindacato.

units.id: mission:FW Conservatory 2|In the spaceport, it does not take long to locate Ijs; he is supervising a crew that is loading trade goods onto several Free Worlds ships. "Glad to see you, <first>," he says. "These three ships need to get to Tarazed and back without being destroyed by pirates... or by the Republic. They'll be bringing back a selection of terraforming equipment supplied from Tarazed and, if you can believe it, the Syndicate as well! I'm pretty sure they know I'm involved in this, so I wonder if this is just a ploy to keep me out of their hair after the war is over, but I won't be complaining about the help.|216|0
units.english: In the spaceport, it does not take long to locate Ijs; he is supervising a crew that is loading trade goods onto several Free Worlds ships. "Glad to see you, <first>," he says. "These three ships need to get to Tarazed and back without being destroyed by pirates... or by the Republic. They'll be bringing back a selection of terraforming equipment supplied from Tarazed and, if you can believe it, the Syndicate as well! I'm pretty sure they know I'm involved in this, so I wonder if this is just a ploy to keep me out of their hair after the war is over, but I won't be complaining about the help.
units.italian: Nello spazioporto non ci vuole molto a trovare Ijs; sta sovrintendendo a un equipaggio che carica merci su diverse navi delle Free Worlds. "Sono contento di vederti, <first>," dice. "Queste tre navi devono arrivare su Tarazed e tornare senza essere distrutte dai pirati... o dalla Repubblica. Torneranno con una selezione di equipaggiamento per la terraformazione fornito da Tarazed e, se ci credi, anche dal Sindacato! Sono abbastanza sicuro che sappiano che ci sono coinvolto, quindi mi chiedo se non sia solo una manovra per tenermi fuori dai piedi dopo la fine della guerra, ma non mi lamenterò dell'aiuto.

units.id: mission:FW Conservatory 2|	"Think you can tag along and protect the freighters?"|217|0
units.english: "Think you can tag along and protect the freighters?"
units.italian: "Pensi di poter venire con noi e proteggere i mercantili?"

units.id: mission:FW Conservatory 2|	"Sure thing!"|219|0
units.english: "Sure thing!"
units.italian: "Certamente!"

units.id: mission:FW Conservatory 2|	"I've got another pressing mission. Can I come back and do this later?"|221|0
units.english: "I've got another pressing mission. Can I come back and do this later?"
units.italian: "Ho un'altra missione urgente. Posso tornare a farlo più tardi?"

units.id: mission:FW Conservatory 2|	"Sure," he says. "But the longer we wait, the longer it will be until the Conservatory is up and running, so come back soon."|222|0
units.english: "Sure," he says. "But the longer we wait, the longer it will be until the Conservatory is up and running, so come back soon."
units.italian: "Certo," dice. "Ma più aspettiamo, più tempo passerà prima che il Conservatorio sia operativo, quindi torna presto."

units.id: mission:FW Conservatory 2|It looks like Ijs is still in need of an escort for the freighters to bring equipment for the Conservatory from <planet> to <origin>. Do you offer to help?|226|0
units.english: It looks like Ijs is still in need of an escort for the freighters to bring equipment for the Conservatory from <planet> to <origin>. Do you offer to help?
units.italian: Sembra che Ijs abbia ancora bisogno di una scorta per i mercantili che devono portare l'attrezzatura per il Conservatorio da <planet> a <origin>. Ti offri di aiutare?

units.id: mission:FW Conservatory 2|	(Yes.)|228|0
units.english: (Yes.)
units.italian: (Sì.)

units.id: mission:FW Conservatory 2|	(No, still busy.)|229|0
units.english: (No, still busy.)
units.italian: (No, sono ancora impegnato.)

units.id: mission:FW Conservatory 2|	You contact Ijs and tell him that you're ready to escort the ships. He shows you the freighters, a collection of three Argosies, and wishes you luck on your journey.|232|0
units.english: You contact Ijs and tell him that you're ready to escort the ships. He shows you the freighters, a collection of three Argosies, and wishes you luck on your journey.
units.italian: Contatti Ijs e gli dici che sei pronto a scortare le navi. Ti mostra i mercantili, una collezione di tre Argosy, e ti augura buona fortuna per il viaggio.

units.id: mission:FW Conservatory 2|dialog|252|0
units.english: You have reached <planet>, but you left part of your convoy behind! Better depart and wait for them to arrive in this star system.
units.italian: Hai raggiunto <planet>, ma hai lasciato indietro una parte del tuo convoglio! Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivino in questo sistema.

units.id: mission:FW Conservatory 2|dialog|254|0
units.english: Your three escorts land safely on Tarazed. Their cargo is quickly offloaded and exchanged for the terraforming equipment that the Conservatory needs.
units.italian: Le tue tre scorte atterrano su Tarazed senza problemi. Il loro carico viene rapidamente scaricato e scambiato con l'equipaggiamento per la terraformazione che serve al Conservatorio.

units.id: mission:FW Conservatory 2B|name|260|0
units.english: Escort to <planet>
units.italian: Scorta per <planet>

units.id: mission:FW Conservatory 2B|description|261|0
units.english: Escort this Free Worlds convoy of terraforming equipment back to <destination>.
units.italian: Scorta questo convoglio di equipaggiamento per la terraformazione delle Free Worlds fino a <destination>.

units.id: mission:FW Conservatory 2B|dialog|288|0
units.english: You have reached <planet>, but you left part of your convoy behind! Better depart and wait for them to arrive in this star system.
units.italian: Hai raggiunto <planet>, ma hai lasciato indietro una parte del tuo convoglio! Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivino in questo sistema.

units.id: mission:FW Conservatory 2B|log|292|0
units.english: Helped to transport some items for building a public university and terraforming research center on Winter. Ijs Springborn will be one of the professors. Surprisingly, the Syndicate helped supply some of the equipment for the Conservatory.
units.italian: Hai aiutato a trasportare materiale per costruire un'università pubblica e un centro di ricerca sulla terraformazione su Winter. Ijs Springborn sarà uno dei professori. Sorprendentemente, il Sindacato ha contribuito a fornire parte dell'equipaggiamento per il Conservatorio.

units.id: mission:FW Conservatory 2B|Ijs meets your convoy as it lands, and checks off each item on a clipboard as it is unloaded. Lynn is with him, looking over the various machines to make sure they are all in working order. "I hope you didn't have any trouble," says Ijs, as he hands you your payment of <payment>.|294|0
units.english: Ijs meets your convoy as it lands, and checks off each item on a clipboard as it is unloaded. Lynn is with him, looking over the various machines to make sure they are all in working order. "I hope you didn't have any trouble," says Ijs, as he hands you your payment of <payment>.
units.italian: Ijs incontra il tuo convoglio mentre atterra, e spunta ogni voce su una clipboard mentre viene scaricata. Lynn è con lui, e controlla le varie macchine per assicurarsi che siano tutte funzionanti. "Spero che non abbiate avuto problemi," dice Ijs, porgendoti il pagamento di <payment>.

units.id: mission:FW Conservatory 2B|	"No, none at all."|296|0
units.english: "No, none at all."
units.italian: "No, nessuno."

units.id: mission:FW Conservatory 2B|	"A few pirates, nothing I couldn't handle."|297|0
units.english: "A few pirates, nothing I couldn't handle."
units.italian: "Qualche pirata, niente che non potessi gestire."

units.id: mission:FW Conservatory 2B|	"Actually, we were lucky to make it back alive."|298|0
units.english: "Actually, we were lucky to make it back alive."
units.italian: "A dire il vero, siamo stati fortunati a tornare vivi."

units.id: mission:FW Conservatory 2B|	"Glad to hear it," he says.|300|0
units.english: "Glad to hear it," he says.
units.italian: "Sono contento di sentirlo," dice.

units.id: mission:FW Conservatory 2B|	"That's too bad," he says. "This war must be making the Dirt Belt even more unstable than usual. Hopefully we'll be able to do something about that soon."|303|0
units.english: "That's too bad," he says. "This war must be making the Dirt Belt even more unstable than usual. Hopefully we'll be able to do something about that soon."
units.italian: "Peccato," dice. "Questa guerra deve rendere la Fascia di Terra ancora più instabile del solito. Speriamo di poter fare qualcosa al riguardo presto."

units.id: mission:FW Conservatory 2B|	"Is there anything else you need me to do?" you ask.|305|0
units.english: "Is there anything else you need me to do?" you ask.
units.italian: "C'è qualcos'altro che devo fare per te?" chiedi.

units.id: mission:FW Conservatory 2B|	"Not at the moment," he says. "I'll send you a message when we do. Thanks for your help, and if you hear any more news about Katya, please let me know."|306|0
units.english: "Not at the moment," he says. "I'll send you a message when we do. Thanks for your help, and if you hear any more news about Katya, please let me know."
units.italian: "Non al momento," dice. "Ti manderò un messaggio quando ci sarà. Grazie per l'aiuto, e se senti altre notizie su Katya, per favore fammelo sapere."

units.id: mission:FW Deep Memorial|As you disembark, you hear the sounds of warning sirens and heavy machinery coming from the edge of <planet>'s spaceport. It doesn't take long to find the source of the noise: several large construction vehicles are paving a large clearing at the edge of a cliff. At its center are nine large walls covered in letters, with spaces reserved for an additional fourteen walls. The largest wall is emblazoned with the text "Free Worlds War Memorial." Already, there are friends and family paying their respects to the ever-growing number of fallen.|318|0
units.english: As you disembark, you hear the sounds of warning sirens and heavy machinery coming from the edge of <planet>'s spaceport. It doesn't take long to find the source of the noise: several large construction vehicles are paving a large clearing at the edge of a cliff. At its center are nine large walls covered in letters, with spaces reserved for an additional fourteen walls. The largest wall is emblazoned with the text "Free Worlds War Memorial." Already, there are friends and family paying their respects to the ever-growing number of fallen.
units.italian: Mentre sbarchi, senti il suono di sirene di avvertimento e macchinari pesanti provenire dal margine dello spazioporto di <planet>. Non ci vuole molto a trovare la fonte del rumore: diversi grossi mezzi da costruzione stanno pavimentando un'ampia radura sul bordo di una scogliera. Al centro ci sono nove grandi pareti coperte di lettere, con spazio riservato per altre quattordici. Sulla parete più grande campeggia la scritta "Memoriale di Guerra delle Free Worlds". Già ci sono amici e familiari che rendono omaggio al numero sempre crescente di caduti.

units.id: mission:FW Deep Memorial|label|322|0
units.english: brower death
units.italian: brower death

units.id: mission:FW Deep Memorial|	As you inspect the walls, you recognize one of the names:|323|0
units.english: As you inspect the walls, you recognize one of the names:
units.italian: Mentre ispezioni le pareti, riconosci uno dei nomi:

units.id: mission:FW Deep Memorial|		MSGT IRENE BROWER|325|0
units.english: MSGT IRENE BROWER
units.italian: SGT MAGGIORE IRENE BROWER

units.id: mission:FW Deep Memorial|			KILLED AT THE ATTACK ON GREENROCK|326|0
units.english: KILLED AT THE ATTACK ON GREENROCK
units.italian: UCCISA NELL'ATTACCO A GREENROCK

units.id: mission:FW Deep Memorial|	The sound of construction persists as you return to the main spaceport.|329|0
units.english: The sound of construction persists as you return to the main spaceport.
units.italian: Il rumore dei lavori continua mentre torni allo spazioporto principale.

units.id: mission:FW Flamethrower 1|name|337|0
units.english: Weapon Testing
units.italian: Prova delle armi

units.id: mission:FW Flamethrower 1|description|338|0
units.english: When you have time, report to <destination>, where Barmy Edward has another weapon he would like you to test.
units.italian: Quando avrai tempo, presentati su <destination>, dove Barmy Edward ha un'altra arma che vorrebbe farti provare.

units.id: mission:FW Flamethrower 1|A message arrives for you soon after you land. It's from Barmy Edward, the weapons engineer at Kraz Cybernetics. He writes: "Hello again, Captain! I've been working on a new weapon, and for some reason no one else wants to help out with the testing. If you're interested in getting your hands on some hot new technology, drop by Rust and come visit our factory."|348|0
units.english: A message arrives for you soon after you land. It's from Barmy Edward, the weapons engineer at Kraz Cybernetics. He writes: "Hello again, Captain! I've been working on a new weapon, and for some reason no one else wants to help out with the testing. If you're interested in getting your hands on some hot new technology, drop by Rust and come visit our factory."
units.italian: Poco dopo l'atterraggio ti arriva un messaggio. È di Barmy Edward, l'ingegnere delle armi della Kraz Cybernetics. Scrive: "Salve di nuovo, Capitano! Sto lavorando a una nuova arma, e per qualche ragione nessun altro vuole aiutare con le prove. Se ti interessa mettere le mani su una tecnologia nuova di zecca, passa da Rust e vieni a visitare la nostra fabbrica."

units.id: mission:FW Flamethrower 2|name|355|0
units.english: Weapon Testing
units.italian: Prova delle armi

units.id: mission:FW Flamethrower 2|description|356|0
units.english: A test ship with new weaponry is in orbit around <planet>. Fight and disable it (but do not board or destroy it!) and then land to give Barmy Edward feedback on its performance.
units.italian: Una nave di prova con nuove armi è in orbita intorno a <planet>. Combattila e mettila fuori uso (ma non abbordarla né distruggerla!) e poi atterra per dare a Barmy Edward un parere sulle sue prestazioni.

units.id: mission:FW Flamethrower 2|You received a message recently from Barmy Edward, asking you to stop by the Kraz Cybernetics facility to help test a new weapon. Do you want to visit them now?|363|0
units.english: You received a message recently from Barmy Edward, asking you to stop by the Kraz Cybernetics facility to help test a new weapon. Do you want to visit them now?
units.italian: Hai ricevuto di recente un messaggio da Barmy Edward, che ti chiedeva di passare dalla struttura della Kraz Cybernetics per aiutare a provare una nuova arma. Vuoi andare a trovarli adesso?

units.id: mission:FW Flamethrower 2|	(Yes.)|365|0
units.english: (Yes.)
units.italian: (Sì.)

units.id: mission:FW Flamethrower 2|	(No.)|366|0
units.english: (No.)
units.italian: (No.)

units.id: mission:FW Flamethrower 2|	You give your name to the receptionist, and she directs you to the hangar where the weapons group does their design and prototyping. Barmy Edward shakes your hand warmly and says, "Here's the deal. We've got a new weapon, something a little out of the ordinary. We're hoping it will be useful against the pirates, in particular. Interested in helping us?"|369|0
units.english: You give your name to the receptionist, and she directs you to the hangar where the weapons group does their design and prototyping. Barmy Edward shakes your hand warmly and says, "Here's the deal. We've got a new weapon, something a little out of the ordinary. We're hoping it will be useful against the pirates, in particular. Interested in helping us?"
units.italian: Dici il tuo nome alla reception, e lei ti indirizza all'hangar dove il gruppo delle armi fa progettazione e prototipi. Barmy Edward ti stringe la mano con calore e dice: "Ecco come stanno le cose. Abbiamo una nuova arma, qualcosa di un po' fuori dal comune. Speriamo che sia utile contro i pirati, in particolare. Ti interessa aiutarci?"

units.id: mission:FW Flamethrower 2|	"Of course," you say.|370|0
units.english: "Of course," you say.
units.italian: "Certamente," dici.

units.id: mission:FW Flamethrower 2|	"Great," he says. "I won't share the details, because I want you to get the full effect of the surprise. But, there's a ship in orbit, the Doombat, that has been fitted with a few of these new weapons. Your job will be to fight it and disable it, then tell us what you think of its weapons."|371|0
units.english: "Great," he says. "I won't share the details, because I want you to get the full effect of the surprise. But, there's a ship in orbit, the Doombat, that has been fitted with a few of these new weapons. Your job will be to fight it and disable it, then tell us what you think of its weapons."
units.italian: "Ottimo," dice. "Non ti dirò i dettagli, perché voglio che tu abbia l'effetto sorpresa completo. Ma c'è una nave in orbita, la Doombat, che è stata equipaggiata con alcune di queste nuove armi. Il tuo compito sarà combatterla e metterla fuori uso, poi dirci che cosa pensi delle sue armi."

units.id: mission:FW Flamethrower 2|	He shakes a finger in your face and says, "Now mind you, we just want you to disable the Doombat, not destroy it. We bought it from a scrapyard, so it's barely spaceworthy, but all the same I want to be able to keep using it for future tests. Understood?"|372|0
units.english: He shakes a finger in your face and says, "Now mind you, we just want you to disable the Doombat, not destroy it. We bought it from a scrapyard, so it's barely spaceworthy, but all the same I want to be able to keep using it for future tests. Understood?"
units.italian: Ti agita un dito davanti al viso e dice: "Occhio, vogliamo solo che tu metta fuori uso la Doombat, non che la distrugga. L'abbiamo comprata da un deposito di rottami, quindi a malapena tiene lo spazio, ma voglio comunque poterla usare per prove future. Chiaro?"

units.id: mission:FW Flamethrower 2|	"Okay, I promise not to destroy it or steal it."|374|0
units.english: "Okay, I promise not to destroy it or steal it."
units.italian: "Va bene, prometto di non distruggerla né di rubarla."

units.id: mission:FW Flamethrower 2|	"Sorry, this sounds a bit too risky. I'd rather not be involved in this sort of testing."|375|0
units.english: "Sorry, this sounds a bit too risky. I'd rather not be involved in this sort of testing."
units.italian: "Scusa, mi sembra un po' troppo rischioso. Preferirei non essere coinvolto in questo tipo di prove."

units.id: mission:FW Flamethrower 2|	"Great," he says, rubbing his hands together with a gleeful expression on his face. He's clearly looking forward to hearing what you think of his latest invention.|377|0
units.english: "Great," he says, rubbing his hands together with a gleeful expression on his face. He's clearly looking forward to hearing what you think of his latest invention.
units.italian: "Ottimo," dice, strofinandosi le mani con un'espressione compiaciuta. È chiaramente impaziente di sentire che cosa pensi della sua ultima invenzione.

units.id: mission:FW Flamethrower 2|dialog|386|0
units.english: You've landed on <planet>, but you have not disabled the <npc> yet. Disable it before returning.
units.italian: Sei atterrato su <planet>, ma non hai ancora messo fuori uso la <npc>. Mettila fuori uso prima di tornare.

units.id: mission:FW Flamethrower 2|log|389|0
units.english: Assisted Barmy Edward with another weapon test: this time, a flamethrower weapon that works by overheating and disabling its target rather than dealing lots of damage to it. It may or may not be useful in actual combat.
units.italian: Hai assistito Barmy Edward in un'altra prova d'arma: questa volta un lanciafiamme che funziona surriscaldando e mettendo fuori uso il bersaglio invece di infliggergli molti danni. Potrebbe o non potrebbe essere utile in combattimento reale.

units.id: mission:FW Flamethrower 2|You head to the hangar to meet up with Barmy Edward, and find him tinkering with a large gun you don't recognize. Presumably, this is the Flamethrower that you were just attacked with in orbit. "It runs on hyperspace fuel, you see," he says. "So, what did you think?"|392|0
units.english: You head to the hangar to meet up with Barmy Edward, and find him tinkering with a large gun you don't recognize. Presumably, this is the Flamethrower that you were just attacked with in orbit. "It runs on hyperspace fuel, you see," he says. "So, what did you think?"
units.italian: Ti dirigi all'hangar per incontrare Barmy Edward, e lo trovi che armeggia con un grosso cannone che non riconosci. Presumibilmente è il lanciafiamme con cui sei appena stato attaccato in orbita. "Funziona a carburante iperspaziale, vedi," dice. "Allora, che cosa ne pensi?"

units.id: mission:FW Flamethrower 2|	"It's a terrifying weapon."|394|0
units.english: "It's a terrifying weapon."
units.italian: "È un'arma terrificante."

units.id: mission:FW Flamethrower 2|	"It looks impressive, but it didn't do very much damage."|396|0
units.english: "It looks impressive, but it didn't do very much damage."
units.italian: "Sembra impressionante, ma non ha fatto molti danni."

units.id: mission:FW Flamethrower 2|	"Your flamethrower doesn't seem to work very well."|398|0
units.english: "Your flamethrower doesn't seem to work very well."
units.italian: "Il tuo lanciafiamme non sembra funzionare molto bene."

units.id: mission:FW Flamethrower 2|	"Isn't it?" he says. "Mostly useful against small ships, of course, or ships that are running way too close to their thermal thresholds. Need to be almost on top of your target to get the full effect, too. But the ability to temporarily disable a ship without even dropping its shields first could be quite useful in certain tactical situations."|401|0
units.english: "Isn't it?" he says. "Mostly useful against small ships, of course, or ships that are running way too close to their thermal thresholds. Need to be almost on top of your target to get the full effect, too. But the ability to temporarily disable a ship without even dropping its shields first could be quite useful in certain tactical situations."
units.italian: "Non è vero?" dice. "Utile soprattutto contro navi piccole, naturalmente, o navi che viaggiano fin troppo vicino alle loro soglie termiche. Bisogna anche essere quasi addosso al bersaglio per ottenere l'effetto completo. Ma la capacità di mettere temporaneamente fuori uso una nave senza nemmeno abbatterne gli scudi potrebbe essere piuttosto utile in certe situazioni tattiche."

units.id: mission:FW Flamethrower 2|	"When will it be available for sale?" you ask.|402|0
units.english: "When will it be available for sale?" you ask.
units.italian: "Quando sarà in vendita?" chiedi.

units.id: mission:FW Flamethrower 2|	"No, doing damage isn't the point," he says. "The idea is to heat up the target to the point where it goes into emergency thermal shutdown. Basically a way to temporarily disable even a ship with full shields. Of course, big ships can absorb an awful lot of heat without changing temperature much, so I suspect it will be most useful against smaller targets. You've got to get right up close to them to get the full heating effect, which isn't going to be easy if you're dealing with larger warships like the Navy ones."|405|0
units.english: "No, doing damage isn't the point," he says. "The idea is to heat up the target to the point where it goes into emergency thermal shutdown. Basically a way to temporarily disable even a ship with full shields. Of course, big ships can absorb an awful lot of heat without changing temperature much, so I suspect it will be most useful against smaller targets. You've got to get right up close to them to get the full heating effect, which isn't going to be easy if you're dealing with larger warships like the Navy ones."
units.italian: "No, fare danni non è il punto," dice. "L'idea è riscaldare il bersaglio fino a farlo andare in spegnimento termico d'emergenza. In pratica un modo per mettere temporaneamente fuori uso anche una nave con gli scudi pieni. Naturalmente le navi grandi possono assorbire moltissimo calore senza cambiare granché di temperatura, quindi sospetto che sarà più utile contro bersagli piccoli. Devi arrivare proprio a ridosso per ottenere l'effetto di riscaldamento completo, il che non sarà facile se hai a che fare con navi da guerra più grandi come quelle della Marina."

units.id: mission:FW Flamethrower 2|	"That is an interesting idea," you say. "Are they available for sale yet?"|406|0
units.english: "That is an interesting idea," you say. "Are they available for sale yet?"
units.italian: "È un'idea interessante," dici. "Sono già in vendita?"

units.id: mission:FW Flamethrower 2|	"Oh." He seems somewhat dejected. "Well, if you were flying a smaller ship, you might think differently. Or if your ship didn't have adequate cooling. Or maybe the Doombat didn't get close enough to give you the full power of it. My idea was to target pirate ships with those illegal Modified Blasters that run hotter than usual."|409|0
units.english: "Oh." He seems somewhat dejected. "Well, if you were flying a smaller ship, you might think differently. Or if your ship didn't have adequate cooling. Or maybe the Doombat didn't get close enough to give you the full power of it. My idea was to target pirate ships with those illegal Modified Blasters that run hotter than usual."
units.italian: "Oh." Sembra un po' abbattuto. "Beh, se pilotassi una nave più piccola, forse la penseresti diversamente. O se la tua nave non avesse un raffreddamento adeguato. O magari la Doombat non è riuscita ad avvicinarsi abbastanza per darti tutta la sua potenza. La mia idea era di prendere di mira le navi pirata con quei Blaster Modificati illegali che scaldano più del normale."

units.id: mission:FW Flamethrower 2|	"I guess that makes sense," you say, "although I wouldn't want to run out of jump fuel by accident. Are you going to be making them available for sale?"|410|0
units.english: "I guess that makes sense," you say, "although I wouldn't want to run out of jump fuel by accident. Are you going to be making them available for sale?"
units.italian: "Immagino che abbia senso," dici, "anche se non vorrei restare senza carburante di salto per sbaglio. Le metterai in vendita?"

units.id: mission:FW Flamethrower 2|	"Well, I should have an initial model for sale in a month or so," he says. "I'll be interested to see what uses you or anyone else might find for them. Anyway, thanks for your help." You say goodbye and head back to your ship.|413|0
units.english: "Well, I should have an initial model for sale in a month or so," he says. "I'll be interested to see what uses you or anyone else might find for them. Anyway, thanks for your help." You say goodbye and head back to your ship.
units.italian: "Beh, dovrei avere un modello iniziale in vendita fra un mese circa," dice. "Sarò curioso di vedere che usi ci troverai tu, o chiunque altro. Comunque, grazie per l'aiuto." Vi salutate e torni alla tua nave.

units.id: mission:FW Wolf Pack 1|name|432|0
units.english: Ramscoop Technology
units.italian: Tecnologia dei ramscoop

units.id: mission:FW Wolf Pack 1|description|433|0
units.english: Travel to <planet> in the Deep, where Free Worlds sympathizers will share details of a new ramscoop technology. (You may have to bribe planets along the way to get permission to refuel.)
units.italian: Recati su <planet>, nel Deep, dove dei simpatizzanti delle Free Worlds condivideranno i dettagli di una nuova tecnologia per i ramscoop. (Potrebbe essere necessario corrompere dei pianeti lungo la strada per ottenere il permesso di fare rifornimento.)

units.id: mission:FW Wolf Pack 1|When you stop by the spaceport bar, a militia officer who you don't recognize gestures for you to join him. "Captain <last>!" he says. "I'd be honored if you'd let me buy you a drink."|447|0
units.english: When you stop by the spaceport bar, a militia officer who you don't recognize gestures for you to join him. "Captain <last>!" he says. "I'd be honored if you'd let me buy you a drink."
units.italian: Quando entri nel bar dello spazioporto, un ufficiale della milizia che non riconosci ti fa cenno di unirti a lui. "Capitano <last>!" dice. "Sarebbe un onore se mi lasciassi offrirti da bere."

units.id: mission:FW Wolf Pack 1|	"Thank you!"|449|0
units.english: "Thank you!"
units.italian: "Grazie!"

units.id: mission:FW Wolf Pack 1|	"Sorry, I don't drink."|451|0
units.english: "Sorry, I don't drink."
units.italian: "Scusa, non bevo."

units.id: mission:FW Wolf Pack 1|	"Then what are you doing in a bar?" he asks. "Never mind, don't answer that. I assume you're here looking for valuable work to do, and if that's the case, I could really use your help."|452|0
units.english: "Then what are you doing in a bar?" he asks. "Never mind, don't answer that. I assume you're here looking for valuable work to do, and if that's the case, I could really use your help."
units.italian: "Allora che cosa ci fai in un bar?" chiede. "Lascia stare, non rispondere. Immagino che tu sia qui in cerca di lavoro utile da fare, e se è così, mi servirebbe davvero il tuo aiuto."

units.id: mission:FW Wolf Pack 1|	He buys you a drink, and you sit down at his table. After making small talk for a few minutes, he says, "By the way, I could really use your help with a mission for the Free Worlds."|455|0
units.english: He buys you a drink, and you sit down at his table. After making small talk for a few minutes, he says, "By the way, I could really use your help with a mission for the Free Worlds."
units.italian: Ti offre da bere, e ti siedi al suo tavolo. Dopo qualche minuto di conversazione, dice: "A proposito, mi servirebbe davvero il tuo aiuto per una missione per le Free Worlds."

units.id: mission:FW Wolf Pack 1|	"Okay," you say, "tell me more."|457|0
units.english: "Okay," you say, "tell me more."
units.italian: "Va bene," dici, "dimmi di più."

units.id: mission:FW Wolf Pack 1|	He says, "You probably know that we have a network of Free Worlds sympathizers throughout much of Republic space. One of our contacts recently sent us word of a new technology that is for sale in the Deep, which could be very useful to us. But they have no way to ship it to us, so I need someone who can travel up to the Deep and retrieve it."|458|0
units.english: He says, "You probably know that we have a network of Free Worlds sympathizers throughout much of Republic space. One of our contacts recently sent us word of a new technology that is for sale in the Deep, which could be very useful to us. But they have no way to ship it to us, so I need someone who can travel up to the Deep and retrieve it."
units.italian: Dice: "Probabilmente saprai che abbiamo una rete di simpatizzanti delle Free Worlds in buona parte dello spazio della Repubblica. Uno dei nostri contatti ci ha recentemente informato di una nuova tecnologia in vendita nel Deep, che potrebbe esserci molto utile. Ma non hanno modo di spedircela, quindi mi serve qualcuno che possa salire fino al Deep e recuperarla."

units.id: mission:FW Wolf Pack 1|	"Will your contacts also provide me with planets to refuel on along the way?"|460|0
units.english: "Will your contacts also provide me with planets to refuel on along the way?"
units.italian: "I tuoi contatti mi forniranno anche dei pianeti dove fare rifornimento lungo la strada?"

units.id: mission:FW Wolf Pack 1|	"The Deep is farther away than my fuel tanks can take me."|461|0
units.english: "The Deep is farther away than my fuel tanks can take me."
units.italian: "Il Deep è più lontano di quanto possano portarmi i miei serbatoi."

units.id: mission:FW Wolf Pack 1|	"You'll have to bribe some Dirt Belt worlds into letting you land, to get there," he says. "Or, you could wait for the next time there's a ceasefire. But here's the great part: if this works, you won't need to pay any bribes on the way back, because the new technology we're after is a super-efficient ramscoop. What do you say?"|462|0
units.english: "You'll have to bribe some Dirt Belt worlds into letting you land, to get there," he says. "Or, you could wait for the next time there's a ceasefire. But here's the great part: if this works, you won't need to pay any bribes on the way back, because the new technology we're after is a super-efficient ramscoop. What do you say?"
units.italian: "Dovrai corrompere qualche mondo della Fascia di Terra perché ti lasci atterrare, per arrivarci," dice. "Oppure potresti aspettare la prossima volta che c'è un cessate il fuoco. Ma ecco la parte bella: se funziona, non dovrai pagare nessuna tangente al ritorno, perché la nuova tecnologia che cerchiamo è un ramscoop superefficiente. Che ne dici?"

units.id: mission:FW Wolf Pack 1|	"Okay, I'll give it a try."|464|0
units.english: "Okay, I'll give it a try."
units.italian: "Va bene, ci provo."

units.id: mission:FW Wolf Pack 1|	"Sorry, this sounds way too risky to me."|466|0
units.english: "Sorry, this sounds way too risky to me."
units.italian: "Scusa, mi sembra troppo rischioso."

units.id: mission:FW Wolf Pack 1B|name|473|0
units.english: Ramscoop Technology
units.italian: Tecnologia dei ramscoop

units.id: mission:FW Wolf Pack 1B|description|474|0
units.english: Return to Free space with the plans for a new, more efficient ramscoop, and deliver them to Delta V Corporation on <destination>.
units.italian: Torna nello spazio delle Free Worlds con i progetti di un nuovo ramscoop più efficiente, e consegnali alla Delta V Corporation su <destination>.

units.id: mission:FW Wolf Pack 1B|You land your ship by night in a private hangar that you assume is owned by one of the elite families on <origin>. Your contact is wearing a black mask over his face. That seems unnecessary to you, but perhaps he is just really enjoying the thrill of being involved in something illegal. He hands you a data card and says, "This contains all the information you will need to build your own Catalytic Ramscoop. And before you leave, you may also visit our private outfitter and purchase one of your own, if you wish."|485|0
units.english: You land your ship by night in a private hangar that you assume is owned by one of the elite families on <origin>. Your contact is wearing a black mask over his face. That seems unnecessary to you, but perhaps he is just really enjoying the thrill of being involved in something illegal. He hands you a data card and says, "This contains all the information you will need to build your own Catalytic Ramscoop. And before you leave, you may also visit our private outfitter and purchase one of your own, if you wish."
units.italian: Fai atterrare la nave di notte in un hangar privato che supponi appartenga a una delle famiglie dell'élite di <origin>. Il tuo contatto indossa una maschera nera sul viso. Ti sembra inutile, ma forse si sta solo divertendo molto al brivido di essere coinvolto in qualcosa di illegale. Ti porge una scheda dati e dice: "Questa contiene tutte le informazioni che ti servono per costruire un tuo Ramscoop Catalitico. E prima di andartene, puoi anche visitare il nostro banco degli equipaggiamenti privato e comprarne uno, se vuoi."

units.id: mission:FW Wolf Pack 1B|	"Thank you."|487|0
units.english: "Thank you."
units.italian: "Grazie."

units.id: mission:FW Wolf Pack 1B|	"May I ask who you are and why you sympathize with us?"|489|0
units.english: "May I ask who you are and why you sympathize with us?"
units.italian: "Posso chiedere chi sei e perché simpatizzi per noi?"

units.id: mission:FW Wolf Pack 1B|	"You can call me... Agent Falco. As to my true identity, naturally you will understand that I cannot divulge it."|490|0
units.english: "You can call me... Agent Falco. As to my true identity, naturally you will understand that I cannot divulge it."
units.italian: "Puoi chiamarmi... Agente Falco. Quanto alla mia vera identità, naturalmente capirai che non posso rivelarla."

units.id: mission:FW Wolf Pack 1B|	"Of course," you say.|491|0
units.english: "Of course," you say.
units.italian: "Certamente," dici.

units.id: mission:FW Wolf Pack 1B|	"I wish you the best of luck in your struggle against the evil plutocrats," he says. "May we yet live to see the day when all people live in prosperity and freedom. Farewell, brave insurgent." It is an overly dramatic speech, and sounds like he's been rehearsing it for a while. You respond with what you hope is a properly elegant salute, and he leaves.|493|0
units.english: "I wish you the best of luck in your struggle against the evil plutocrats," he says. "May we yet live to see the day when all people live in prosperity and freedom. Farewell, brave insurgent." It is an overly dramatic speech, and sounds like he's been rehearsing it for a while. You respond with what you hope is a properly elegant salute, and he leaves.
units.italian: "Ti auguro il meglio nella tua lotta contro gli spregevoli plutocrati," dice. "Che possiamo ancora vivere abbastanza da vedere il giorno in cui tutti i popoli vivranno nella prosperità e nella libertà. Addio, coraggioso insorto." È un discorso esageratamente drammatico, e sembra che lo stia provando da un po'. Rispondi con quello che speri sia un saluto adeguatamente elegante, e lui se ne va.

units.id: mission:FW Wolf Pack 1B|log|499|0
units.english: Helped the Free Worlds gain access to new ramscoop technology that has been developed in the Deep. This should make it significantly easier to travel long distances through unfriendly systems.
units.italian: Hai aiutato le Free Worlds a ottenere accesso a una nuova tecnologia per i ramscoop sviluppata nel Deep. Dovrebbe rendere molto più facile viaggiare a lungo attraverso sistemi ostili.

units.id: mission:FW Wolf Pack 1B|dialog|500|0
units.english: You deliver the data card with the details of the Catalytic Ramscoop to the contact you were given in the Delta V corporation. "Excellent," she says. "We have been trying to duplicate their work for months, but this will make it much easier." She hands you a credit chip worth <payment>, and says, "We'll contact you when we've begun mass-producing the new ramscoops. I hope they will be useful in the conflict ahead."
units.italian: Consegni la scheda dati con i dettagli del Ramscoop Catalitico al contatto che ti è stato indicato nella Delta V. "Eccellente," dice. "Stavamo cercando di replicare il loro lavoro da mesi, ma questo renderà tutto molto più facile." Ti porge una scheda di credito del valore di <payment> e dice: "Ti contatteremo quando avremo iniziato la produzione in serie dei nuovi ramscoop. Spero che saranno utili nel conflitto che ci aspetta."

units.id: mission:FW Wolf Pack 2|name|506|0
units.english: "Wolf Pack" Recruiting
units.italian: Reclutamento del "Branco di Lupi"

units.id: mission:FW Wolf Pack 2|description|507|0
units.english: A group identifying themselves as the "Free Worlds Wolf Pack" has asked you to visit them on <planet> if you want to aid their work against the Republic.
units.italian: Un gruppo che si fa chiamare "Branco di Lupi delle Free Worlds" ti ha chiesto di andare a trovarli su <planet> se vuoi aiutare il loro lavoro contro la Repubblica.

units.id: mission:FW Wolf Pack 2|Soon after you land on <origin>, you receive an anonymous message. It reads:|520|0
units.english: Soon after you land on <origin>, you receive an anonymous message. It reads:
units.italian: Poco dopo l'atterraggio su <origin>, ricevi un messaggio anonimo. Dice:

units.id: mission:FW Wolf Pack 2|Dear Captain <last>,|522|0
units.english: Dear Captain <last>,
units.italian: Caro capitano <last>,

units.id: mission:FW Wolf Pack 2|	Thanks to your assistance, the Delta V engineers have succeeded in duplicating Deep Sky's new ramscoop technology. The ramscoop is one piece in a larger plan we have to shift the tide of this war in favor of the Free Worlds, and to bring about an end to the conflict more quickly. If you are interested in hearing more, please visit <planet>, and our representatives will contact you promptly.|523|0
units.english: Thanks to your assistance, the Delta V engineers have succeeded in duplicating Deep Sky's new ramscoop technology. The ramscoop is one piece in a larger plan we have to shift the tide of this war in favor of the Free Worlds, and to bring about an end to the conflict more quickly. If you are interested in hearing more, please visit <planet>, and our representatives will contact you promptly.
units.italian: Grazie al tuo aiuto, gli ingegneri della Delta V sono riusciti a replicare la nuova tecnologia dei ramscoop della Deep Sky. Il ramscoop è un pezzo di un piano più ampio che abbiamo per spostare le sorti di questa guerra a favore delle Free Worlds, e per porre fine al conflitto più rapidamente. Se ti interessa saperne di più, vai su <planet>, e i nostri rappresentanti ti contatteranno subito.

units.id: mission:FW Wolf Pack 2|	Sincerely,|524|0
units.english: Sincerely,
units.italian: Cordiali saluti,

units.id: mission:FW Wolf Pack 2|		The Free Worlds Wolf Pack|525|0
units.english: The Free Worlds Wolf Pack
units.italian: Il Branco di Lupi delle Free Worlds

units.id: mission:FW Wolf Pack 2|You have never heard of this organization before, but you know that "wolf pack" is pirate slang for a temporary alliance formed for the sake of taking on a target larger than any one band of pirates could handle alone.|527|0
units.english: You have never heard of this organization before, but you know that "wolf pack" is pirate slang for a temporary alliance formed for the sake of taking on a target larger than any one band of pirates could handle alone.
units.italian: Non hai mai sentito parlare di questa organizzazione, ma sai che "branco di lupi" è gergo pirata per un'alleanza temporanea formata per affrontare un bersaglio più grande di quanto qualsiasi banda di pirati potrebbe gestire da sola.

units.id: mission:FW Wolf Pack 2A|name|534|0
units.english: Attack Food Convoy
units.italian: Attacca il convoglio di cibo

units.id: mission:FW Wolf Pack 2A|description|535|0
units.english: Destroy three Republic freighters in the <waypoints> system that are carrying food, then report back to <planet> for payment.
units.italian: Distruggi tre mercantili della Repubblica nel sistema <waypoints> che trasportano cibo, poi riferisci su <planet> per il pagamento.

units.id: mission:FW Wolf Pack 2A|Soon after you land, two men in militia uniforms approach your ship, and tell you they represent the "Wolf Pack." They introduce themselves as Rex and Fido; you're pretty sure those are not their real names.|546|0
units.english: Soon after you land, two men in militia uniforms approach your ship, and tell you they represent the "Wolf Pack." They introduce themselves as Rex and Fido; you're pretty sure those are not their real names.
units.italian: Poco dopo l'atterraggio, due uomini in uniforme della milizia si avvicinano alla tua nave e ti dicono di rappresentare il "Branco di Lupi". Si presentano come Rex e Fido; sei abbastanza sicuro che non siano i loro veri nomi.

units.id: mission:FW Wolf Pack 2A|	Once you are in a private room inside your ship, Rex, who is the younger one, says, "With ramscoop technology, our ships will be able to venture deep into the Dirt Belt. Now, Captain, why do you think the Republic is so determined to hold on to the Dirt Belt, even if it means fighting bloody battles? It's clear that the tax revenue isn't worth it."|547|0
units.english: Once you are in a private room inside your ship, Rex, who is the younger one, says, "With ramscoop technology, our ships will be able to venture deep into the Dirt Belt. Now, Captain, why do you think the Republic is so determined to hold on to the Dirt Belt, even if it means fighting bloody battles? It's clear that the tax revenue isn't worth it."
units.italian: Una volta in una stanza privata dentro la tua nave, Rex, il più giovane, dice: "Con la tecnologia dei ramscoop, le nostre navi potranno avventurarsi in profondità nella Fascia di Terra. Ora, Capitano, perché pensi che la Repubblica sia così determinata a tenersi la Fascia di Terra, anche a costo di combattere battaglie sanguinose? È chiaro che le entrate fiscali non valgono la pena."

units.id: mission:FW Wolf Pack 2A|	"Maybe it's just the principle of not ceding territory without a fight."|549|0
units.english: "Maybe it's just the principle of not ceding territory without a fight."
units.italian: "Magari è solo il principio di non cedere territorio senza combattere."

units.id: mission:FW Wolf Pack 2A|	"Maybe they want the resources that the Dirt Belt produces?"|550|0
units.english: "Maybe they want the resources that the Dirt Belt produces?"
units.italian: "Magari vogliono le risorse che produce la Fascia di Terra?"

units.id: mission:FW Wolf Pack 2A|	"Maybe to keep a buffer in between our territory and the worlds that really matter to them, like Earth and the Paradise Planets?"|552|0
units.english: "Maybe to keep a buffer in between our territory and the worlds that really matter to them, like Earth and the Paradise Planets?"
units.italian: "Magari per tenere un cuscinetto fra il nostro territorio e i mondi che per loro contano davvero, come la Terra e i Mondi Paradisiaci?"

units.id: mission:FW Wolf Pack 2A|	"That might be part of it," says Rex, "but there is a larger reason."|553|0
units.english: "That might be part of it," says Rex, "but there is a larger reason."
units.italian: "Potrebbe essere parte della ragione," dice Rex, "ma c'è un motivo più grande."

units.id: mission:FW Wolf Pack 2A|	"Precisely," says Rex, "and one resource in particular is more important to them than all the rest combined."|556|0
units.english: "Precisely," says Rex, "and one resource in particular is more important to them than all the rest combined."
units.italian: "Esattamente," dice Rex, "e una risorsa in particolare è per loro più importante di tutte le altre messe insieme."

units.id: mission:FW Wolf Pack 2A|	The man named Fido, who is older and has a thick beard, spreads out a map on the table. You recognize it as a chart of food prices throughout human space. "Food," says Rex. "The Dirt Belt is the breadbasket of the galaxy. And the Republic is full of teeming, overpopulated worlds that could never hope to feed themselves. If we cut off the supply of food, the Republic will be forced to make peace with us."|558|0
units.english: The man named Fido, who is older and has a thick beard, spreads out a map on the table. You recognize it as a chart of food prices throughout human space. "Food," says Rex. "The Dirt Belt is the breadbasket of the galaxy. And the Republic is full of teeming, overpopulated worlds that could never hope to feed themselves. If we cut off the supply of food, the Republic will be forced to make peace with us."
units.italian: L'uomo di nome Fido, che è più anziano e ha una barba folta, stende una mappa sul tavolo. Riconosci che è un grafico dei prezzi del cibo in tutto lo spazio umano. "Il cibo," dice Rex. "La Fascia di Terra è il granaio della galassia. E la Repubblica è piena di mondi brulicanti e sovrappopolati che non potrebbero mai sperare di sfamarsi da soli. Se tagliamo l'approvvigionamento di cibo, la Repubblica sarà costretta a fare la pace con noi."

units.id: mission:FW Wolf Pack 2A|	Fido says, "We are proposing a concentrated effort to destroy the freighter convoys that bring food to the richest, most densely populated Republic worlds. When their citizens find themselves lacking basic supplies, they will demand an end to the war."|559|0
units.english: Fido says, "We are proposing a concentrated effort to destroy the freighter convoys that bring food to the richest, most densely populated Republic worlds. When their citizens find themselves lacking basic supplies, they will demand an end to the war."
units.italian: Fido dice: "Proponiamo uno sforzo concentrato per distruggere i convogli mercantili che portano cibo ai mondi della Repubblica più ricchi e densamente popolati. Quando i loro cittadini si troveranno senza beni di prima necessità, chiederanno la fine della guerra."

units.id: mission:FW Wolf Pack 2A|	"I'd be glad to join you. That does sound like a much quicker solution than our current policies that the Senate and the Council support."|561|0
units.english: "I'd be glad to join you. That does sound like a much quicker solution than our current policies that the Senate and the Council support."
units.italian: "Sarei felice di unirmi a voi. Sembra davvero una soluzione molto più rapida delle nostre politiche attuali, che il Senato e il Consiglio sostengono."

units.id: mission:FW Wolf Pack 2A|	"You're trying to starve the Republic into submission? Won't that just add more brutality to a war that has already been far too bloody?"|563|0
units.english: "You're trying to starve the Republic into submission? Won't that just add more brutality to a war that has already been far too bloody?"
units.italian: "State cercando di far morire di fame la Repubblica per costringerla a cedere? Non aggiungerà solo più brutalità a una guerra già fin troppo sanguinosa?"

units.id: mission:FW Wolf Pack 2A|	"In the short run, perhaps," says Rex. "But think how many lives will be saved - how many bloody battles will be averted - by forcing them to end this war quickly rather than dragging it out across years of time."|564|0
units.english: "In the short run, perhaps," says Rex. "But think how many lives will be saved - how many bloody battles will be averted - by forcing them to end this war quickly rather than dragging it out across years of time."
units.italian: "Nel breve periodo, forse," dice Rex. "Ma pensa a quante vite si salveranno, a quante battaglie sanguinose si eviteranno, costringendoli a porre fine rapidamente a questa guerra invece di trascinarla per anni."

units.id: mission:FW Wolf Pack 2A|	"I don't buy your argument. If we use such reprehensible tactics to build our new society, the society we build will be as corrupt as the old one."|566|0
units.english: "I don't buy your argument. If we use such reprehensible tactics to build our new society, the society we build will be as corrupt as the old one."
units.italian: "Non mi convince il tuo ragionamento. Se usiamo tattiche così riprovevoli per costruire la nostra nuova società, la società che costruiremo sarà corrotta quanto quella vecchia."

units.id: mission:FW Wolf Pack 2A|	"Okay, you've convinced me. What do you want me to do?"|567|0
units.english: "Okay, you've convinced me. What do you want me to do?"
units.italian: "Va bene, mi hai convinto. Che cosa vuoi che faccia?"

units.id: mission:FW Wolf Pack 2A|	"Very well," says Rex. "Sorry for wasting your time." They leave.|569|0
units.english: "Very well," says Rex. "Sorry for wasting your time." They leave.
units.italian: "Molto bene," dice Rex. "Scusa per averci fatto perdere tempo." Se ne vanno.

units.id: mission:FW Wolf Pack 2A|	"First, you should buy a ramscoop here, if you haven't got one already," says Rex. "Then, your first target is a convoy of three freighters that will be departing from Big Sky in the Sarin system shortly. There may be escorts, but only the freighters themselves need to be destroyed."|572|0
units.english: "First, you should buy a ramscoop here, if you haven't got one already," says Rex. "Then, your first target is a convoy of three freighters that will be departing from Big Sky in the Sarin system shortly. There may be escorts, but only the freighters themselves need to be destroyed."
units.italian: "Prima dovresti comprare un ramscoop qui, se non ne hai già uno," dice Rex. "Poi, il tuo primo bersaglio è un convoglio di tre mercantili che partirà a breve da Big Sky, nel sistema Sarin. Potrebbero esserci delle scorte, ma solo i mercantili stessi devono essere distrutti."

units.id: mission:FW Wolf Pack 2A|dialog|584|0
units.english: You have destroyed all the target freighters. Time to report back to the Wolf Pack on Solace.
units.italian: Hai distrutto tutti i mercantili bersaglio. È ora di riferire al Branco di Lupi su Solace.

units.id: mission:FW Wolf Pack 2A|dialog|593|0
units.english: You've landed on <planet>, but the freighters have not been eliminated yet. Hunt them down in the Sarin system and destroy them before returning.
units.italian: Sei atterrato su <planet>, ma i mercantili non sono ancora stati eliminati. Dalli la caccia nel sistema Sarin e distruggili prima di tornare.

units.id: mission:FW Wolf Pack 2A|log|598|0
