units.english: Destroyed a convoy of Republic freighters that was carrying food from the Dirt Belt. The Paradise Worlds cannot grow all the food that they need to feed their populations, so cutting off the flow of supplies from the Dirt Belt will put pressure on them to make peace with the Free Worlds.
units.italian: Hai distrutto un convoglio di mercantili della Repubblica che trasportava cibo dalla Fascia di Terra. I Mondi Paradisiaci non possono coltivare tutto il cibo che serve a sfamare le loro popolazioni, quindi tagliare il flusso di rifornimenti dalla Fascia di Terra farà pressione su di loro perché facciano la pace con le Free Worlds.

units.id: mission:FW Wolf Pack 2A|dialog|599|0
units.english: Rex, one of the "Wolf Pack" men you spoke with earlier, meets you in the spaceport and hands you a credit chip for <payment>. "Good work," he says. "We'll contact you when we have another target selected."
units.italian: Rex, uno degli uomini del "Branco di Lupi" con cui avevi parlato, ti incontra allo spazioporto e ti porge una scheda di credito da <payment>. "Bel lavoro," dice. "Ti contatteremo quando avremo scelto un altro bersaglio."

units.id: mission:FW Wolf Pack 3|name|627|0
units.english: Attack Food Convoy
units.italian: Attacca il convoglio di cibo

units.id: mission:FW Wolf Pack 3|description|628|0
units.english: Destroy two Republic Bulk Freighters in the Gacrux system that are carrying food, then report back to <planet> for payment.
units.italian: Distruggi due mercantili pesanti della Repubblica nel sistema Gacrux che trasportano cibo, poi riferisci su <planet> per il pagamento.

units.id: mission:FW Wolf Pack 3|You receive another message from the Wolf Pack: "Great work with those freighters, Captain! We've got another target for you, if you're interested: a pair of Bulk Freighters, which you ought to be able to intercept in the Gacrux system. It's an uninhabited system, so you shouldn't have much interference from the Navy. As before, you only need to destroy the freighters, not any other ships you encounter."|642|0
units.english: You receive another message from the Wolf Pack: "Great work with those freighters, Captain! We've got another target for you, if you're interested: a pair of Bulk Freighters, which you ought to be able to intercept in the Gacrux system. It's an uninhabited system, so you shouldn't have much interference from the Navy. As before, you only need to destroy the freighters, not any other ships you encounter."
units.italian: Ricevi un altro messaggio dal Branco di Lupi: "Bel lavoro con quei mercantili, Capitano! Abbiamo un altro bersaglio per te, se ti interessa: una coppia di mercantili pesanti, che dovresti riuscire a intercettare nel sistema Gacrux. È un sistema disabitato, quindi non dovresti avere molte interferenze dalla Marina. Come prima, devi distruggere solo i mercantili, non le altre navi che incontri."

units.id: mission:FW Wolf Pack 3|	Every one of these missions you complete will create more animosity between the Republic and the Free Worlds. But on the other hand, they may be right that it's the fastest way to bring this war to a close.|643|0
units.english: Every one of these missions you complete will create more animosity between the Republic and the Free Worlds. But on the other hand, they may be right that it's the fastest way to bring this war to a close.
units.italian: Ognuna di queste missioni che completi creerà più ostilità fra la Repubblica e le Free Worlds. D'altra parte, potrebbe essere vero che è il modo più rapido per chiudere questa guerra.

units.id: mission:FW Wolf Pack 3|dialog|658|0
units.english: The food convoy has been destroyed. You can now return to Solace.
units.italian: Il convoglio di cibo è stato distrutto. Ora puoi tornare su Solace.

units.id: mission:FW Wolf Pack 3|dialog|668|0
units.english: You've landed on <planet>, but the freighters have not been eliminated yet. Hunt them down in the Gacrux system and destroy them before returning.
units.italian: Sei atterrato su <planet>, ma i mercantili non sono ancora stati eliminati. Dalli la caccia nel sistema Gacrux e distruggili prima di tornare.

units.id: mission:FW Wolf Pack 3|log|674|0
units.english: Destroyed an even larger Republic food convoy. They are probably beginning to feel the pressure now, because they have clearly started to divert warships from the front to defend these convoys.
units.italian: Hai distrutto un convoglio di cibo della Repubblica ancora più grande. Probabilmente ora cominciano a sentire la pressione, perché hanno chiaramente iniziato a sottrarre navi da guerra dal fronte per difendere questi convogli.

units.id: mission:FW Wolf Pack 3|dialog|675|0
units.english: Once again, Rex from the Wolf Pack meets you soon after your ship lands. This time, he pays you <payment>. "I hope they didn't give you any trouble," he says. "We'll be in touch when there's another target to strike."
units.italian: Ancora una volta Rex del Branco di Lupi ti incontra poco dopo l'atterraggio. Questa volta ti paga <payment>. "Spero che non ti abbiano dato problemi," dice. "Ci faremo sentire quando ci sarà un altro bersaglio da colpire."

units.id: mission:FW Wolf Pack 4|name|701|0
units.english: Attack Food Convoy
units.italian: Attacca il convoglio di cibo

units.id: mission:FW Wolf Pack 4|description|702|0
units.english: Destroy a Republic Auxiliary freighter in the <waypoints> system that is carrying food, then report back to <planet> for payment.
units.italian: Distruggi un mercantile ausiliario della Repubblica nel sistema <waypoints> che trasporta cibo, poi riferisci su <planet> per il pagamento.

units.id: mission:FW Wolf Pack 4|dialog|715|0
units.english: You receive another message from the Wolf Pack: "Hello Captain. If nothing else, we've certainly succeeded in getting some of the Navy's ships diverted from the front, to serve as escorts! Your next target, if you're willing to help us again, will be a bit tougher: an Auxiliary freighter, probably with Navy escorts. The freighter is passing through the <waypoints> system. Interested?"
units.italian: Ricevi un altro messaggio dal Branco di Lupi: "Salve, Capitano. Se non altro, siamo certamente riusciti a far deviare alcune navi della Marina dal fronte, per usarle come scorta! Il tuo prossimo bersaglio, se sei disposto ad aiutarci ancora, sarà un po' più duro: un mercantile ausiliario, probabilmente con scorte della Marina. Il mercantile sta passando per il sistema <waypoints>. Ti interessa?"

units.id: mission:FW Wolf Pack 4|dialog|729|0
units.english: You have eliminated the Auxiliary that was carrying food to the Republic. Time to report back to the Wolf Pack and receive your reward.
units.italian: Hai eliminato l'ausiliario che portava cibo alla Repubblica. È ora di riferire al Branco di Lupi e ricevere la ricompensa.

units.id: mission:FW Wolf Pack 4|dialog|745|0
units.english: You've landed on <planet>, but the freighter has not been eliminated yet. Hunt it down in the Mizar system and destroy it before returning.
units.italian: Sei atterrato su <planet>, ma il mercantile non è ancora stato eliminato. Dallo la caccia nel sistema Mizar e distruggilo prima di tornare.

units.id: mission:FW Wolf Pack 4|log|749|0
units.english: Destroyed a third food convoy. These attacks seem to have succeeded in forcing the Navy to assign capital ships to defend their supply convoys.
units.italian: Hai distrutto un terzo convoglio di cibo. Questi attacchi sembrano essere riusciti a costringere la Marina ad assegnare navi capitali alla difesa dei suoi convogli di rifornimento.

units.id: mission:FW Wolf Pack 4|Rex meets up with you and thanks you for your continued service to the Free Worlds. "If we had a dozen captains as brave as you are," he says, "the war would be over tomorrow." He hands you <payment>, and walks away. You still don't know his real name or who the leaders of the Wolf Pack are, but you are glad to have been able to do something extra to assist the war effort.|752|0
units.english: Rex meets up with you and thanks you for your continued service to the Free Worlds. "If we had a dozen captains as brave as you are," he says, "the war would be over tomorrow." He hands you <payment>, and walks away. You still don't know his real name or who the leaders of the Wolf Pack are, but you are glad to have been able to do something extra to assist the war effort.
units.italian: Rex ti incontra e ti ringrazia per il continuo servizio alle Free Worlds. "Se avessimo una dozzina di capitani coraggiosi come te," dice, "la guerra finirebbe domani." Ti porge <payment> e se ne va. Ancora non sai il suo vero nome né chi siano i capi del Branco di Lupi, ma sei contento di aver potuto fare qualcosa in più per lo sforzo bellico.

units.id: mission:FW Stack Core 1|name|758|0
units.english: Escort convoy from Rand
units.italian: Scorta il convoglio da Rand

units.id: mission:FW Stack Core 1|description|759|0
units.english: Freya asked you to stop by Rand if you are able, to help escort a freighter convoy carrying vital supplies for building some exciting new equipment.
units.italian: Freya ti ha chiesto di passare da Rand se puoi, per aiutare a scortare un convoglio di mercantili che trasporta rifornimenti vitali per costruire un'entusiasmante nuova attrezzatura.

units.id: mission:FW Stack Core 1|You receive a short, encoded message from Freya: "Hi there, Captain! If you happen to be passing by <planet> any time soon, would you mind swinging by there to help escort a freighter convoy? We're working on the development of some exciting new equipment, and the convoy is carrying the supplies we need to complete the project."|768|0
units.english: You receive a short, encoded message from Freya: "Hi there, Captain! If you happen to be passing by <planet> any time soon, would you mind swinging by there to help escort a freighter convoy? We're working on the development of some exciting new equipment, and the convoy is carrying the supplies we need to complete the project."
units.italian: Ricevi un breve messaggio in codice da Freya: "Ciao, Capitano! Se ti capita di passare da <planet> in questi giorni, ti dispiacerebbe fermarti lì per aiutare a scortare un convoglio di mercantili? Stiamo lavorando allo sviluppo di un'entusiasmante nuova attrezzatura, e il convoglio trasporta i rifornimenti che ci servono per completare il progetto."

units.id: mission:FWC Stack Core 1|name|775|0
units.english: Escort convoy from Rand
units.italian: Scorta il convoglio da Rand

units.id: mission:FWC Stack Core 1|description|776|0
units.english: Freya asked you to stop by Rand if you are able, to help escort a freighter convoy carrying vital supplies for building some exciting new equipment.
units.italian: Freya ti ha chiesto di passare da Rand se puoi, per aiutare a scortare un convoglio di mercantili che trasporta rifornimenti vitali per costruire un'entusiasmante nuova attrezzatura.

units.id: mission:FW Stack Core 1B|name|790|0
units.english: Escort convoy from Rand
units.italian: Scorta il convoglio da Rand

units.id: mission:FW Stack Core 1B|description|791|0
units.english: Freya asked you to escort this convoy carrying vital supplies for building some exciting new equipment, to <destination>.
units.italian: Freya ti ha chiesto di scortare questo convoglio che trasporta rifornimenti vitali per costruire un'entusiasmante nuova attrezzatura, fino a <destination>.

units.id: mission:FW Stack Core 1B|Following Freya's instructions, you land on <origin> and tell the spaceport quartermaster that you've been assigned to escort a convoy to <planet>. "Ah yes," he says, "the last of their cargo was just made ready yesterday." He leads you to a cluster of landing pads where three Bulk Freighters are parked. "The pirates have not been much trouble lately," he says, "but the cargo is important enough that they wanted an escort anyway." He leaves before you have a chance to ask any questions about what the freighters are carrying.|799|0
units.english: Following Freya's instructions, you land on <origin> and tell the spaceport quartermaster that you've been assigned to escort a convoy to <planet>. "Ah yes," he says, "the last of their cargo was just made ready yesterday." He leads you to a cluster of landing pads where three Bulk Freighters are parked. "The pirates have not been much trouble lately," he says, "but the cargo is important enough that they wanted an escort anyway." He leaves before you have a chance to ask any questions about what the freighters are carrying.
units.italian: Seguendo le istruzioni di Freya, atterri su <origin> e dici al quartiermastro dello spazioporto che sei stato assegnato a scortare un convoglio fino a <planet>. "Ah, certo," dice, "l'ultimo del loro carico è stato preparato proprio ieri." Ti guida a un gruppo di piazzole dove sono parcheggiati tre mercantili pesanti. "Ultimamente i pirati non hanno dato molti problemi," dice, "ma il carico è abbastanza importante che hanno voluto una scorta comunque." Se ne va prima che tu possa fargli domande su che cosa trasportino i mercantili.

units.id: mission:FW Stack Core 1B|dialog|821|0
units.english: You have reached <planet>, but you left part of your convoy behind! Better depart and wait for them to arrive in this star system.
units.italian: Sei arrivato su <planet>, ma hai lasciato indietro una parte del tuo convoglio! Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivino in questo sistema

units.id: mission:FW Stack Core 1B|dialog|825|0
units.english: You have escorted the convoy safely to its destination. The workers begin unloading some very heavy crates, and one of the freighter captains hands you <payment> and thanks you for your protection.
units.italian: Hai scortato il convoglio sano e salvo a destinazione. Gli operai cominciano a scaricare casse molto pesanti, e uno dei capitani dei mercantili ti porge <payment> e ti ringrazia per la protezione.

units.id: mission:FW Stack Core 1C|log|839|0
units.english: The Free Worlds now has a new reactor core of their own design available for sale, specifically for increasing the Dreadnought's energy performance.
units.italian: Le Free Worlds hanno ora un nuovo nucleo del reattore di loro progettazione in vendita, specificamente per aumentare le prestazioni energetiche del Dreadnought.

units.id: mission:FW Stack Core 1C|You receive a message from Freya: "Hello again, Captain! Thanks for your help escorting the materials to Solace. Ever since we developed the Dreadnoughts people have been talking about how badly we need a generator that can meet their energy needs, and that's what Delta V Corporation has been working on. So, take a look next time you're on Solace or one of our other major manufacturing centers. Sorry for the mystery surrounding the cargo, but we didn't exactly want to advertise that a huge shipment of fissionable material was headed for Free Worlds space."|841|0
units.english: You receive a message from Freya: "Hello again, Captain! Thanks for your help escorting the materials to Solace. Ever since we developed the Dreadnoughts people have been talking about how badly we need a generator that can meet their energy needs, and that's what Delta V Corporation has been working on. So, take a look next time you're on Solace or one of our other major manufacturing centers. Sorry for the mystery surrounding the cargo, but we didn't exactly want to advertise that a huge shipment of fissionable material was headed for Free Worlds space."
units.italian: Ricevi un messaggio da Freya: "Salve di nuovo, Capitano! Grazie per l'aiuto nello scortare i materiali su Solace. Da quando abbiamo sviluppato i Dreadnought tutti parlano di quanto ci serva un generatore all'altezza dei loro bisogni energetici, ed è su questo che la Delta V Corporation ha lavorato. Quindi dai un'occhiata la prossima volta che sei su Solace o in uno dei nostri altri centri di produzione principali. Scusa per il mistero intorno al carico, ma non volevamo certo pubblicizzare che una spedizione enorme di materiale fissile era diretta nello spazio delle Free Worlds."

units.id: mission:FW Greenrock Lost Announcement|While waiting in <planet>'s spaceport for your ship to be refueled, you hear an announcement coming from an unseen loudspeaker. "Attention! The Free Worlds have withdrawn our presence from Greenrock. Be advised that any further travel to the Shaula system may carry the risk of pirate attacks." The message cuts off abruptly, only to repeat a few minutes later.|853|0
units.english: While waiting in <planet>'s spaceport for your ship to be refueled, you hear an announcement coming from an unseen loudspeaker. "Attention! The Free Worlds have withdrawn our presence from Greenrock. Be advised that any further travel to the Shaula system may carry the risk of pirate attacks." The message cuts off abruptly, only to repeat a few minutes later.
units.italian: Mentre aspetti nello spazioporto di <planet> che la tua nave faccia rifornimento, senti un annuncio provenire da un altoparlante che non vedi. "Attenzione! Le Free Worlds hanno ritirato la nostra presenza da Greenrock. Si avvisa che ogni ulteriore viaggio nel sistema Shaula può comportare il rischio di attacchi pirata." Il messaggio si interrompe bruscamente, per ripetersi pochi minuti dopo.

units.id: mission:FW Greenrock Lost Announcement|	A militia captain who paused nearby to listen to the announcement shakes his head before recognizing you. "Well, that's a damn shame, isn't it?"|854|0
units.english: A militia captain who paused nearby to listen to the announcement shakes his head before recognizing you. "Well, that's a damn shame, isn't it?"
units.italian: Un capitano della milizia che si era fermato lì vicino ad ascoltare l'annuncio scuote la testa prima di riconoscerti. "Beh, è un vero peccato, no?"

units.id: mission:FW Greenrock Lost Announcement|	"Yeah, I risked my life and position taking Greenrock."|856|0
units.english: "Yeah, I risked my life and position taking Greenrock."
units.italian: "Sì, ho rischiato la vita e la posizione per prendere Greenrock."

units.id: mission:FW Greenrock Lost Announcement|	"It was probably going to happen sooner or later."|860|0
units.english: "It was probably going to happen sooner or later."
units.italian: "Prima o poi sarebbe successo, probabilmente."

units.id: mission:FW Greenrock Lost Announcement|	"We shouldn't have wasted the resources on it at all."|861|0
units.english: "We shouldn't have wasted the resources on it at all."
units.italian: "Non avremmo dovuto sprecare le risorse per prenderla."

units.id: mission:FW Greenrock Lost Announcement|	"I suppose, but things should have gone differently. The Free Worlds, and the Pact before that, was founded to eliminate piracy from the South, so I thought it was the right thing to do."|862|0
units.english: "I suppose, but things should have gone differently. The Free Worlds, and the Pact before that, was founded to eliminate piracy from the South, so I thought it was the right thing to do."
units.italian: "Immagino, ma le cose sarebbero dovute andare diversamente. Le Free Worlds, e prima ancora il Patto, sono nate per eliminare la pirateria dal Sud, quindi pensavo fosse la cosa giusta da fare."

units.id: mission:FW Greenrock Lost Announcement|	"Well, the most obvious threat to the Free Worlds' sovereignty is the Navy. Attacking Greenrock hasn't helped in that regard."|864|0
units.english: "Well, the most obvious threat to the Free Worlds' sovereignty is the Navy. Attacking Greenrock hasn't helped in that regard."
units.italian: "Beh, la minaccia più ovvia alla sovranità delle Free Worlds è la Marina. Attaccare Greenrock non è servito in questo senso."

units.id: mission:FW Greenrock Lost Announcement|	"Tomek's plan didn't work out, though. The other pirate planets didn't surrender when Greenrock fell, like he had wanted."|866|0
units.english: "Tomek's plan didn't work out, though. The other pirate planets didn't surrender when Greenrock fell, like he had wanted."
units.italian: "Il piano di Tomek però non ha funzionato. Gli altri pianeti pirata non si sono arresi quando Greenrock è caduta, come lui sperava."

units.id: mission:FW Greenrock Lost Announcement|	"That's true. But we mustn't lose sight of our original goals, either. Piracy is a bloody stain on the Southern Rim, and every ship we lose fighting a petty war between Bourne and Earth is a ship that can't protect our families on Solace or Longjump from the horrors of piracy.|867|0
units.english: "That's true. But we mustn't lose sight of our original goals, either. Piracy is a bloody stain on the Southern Rim, and every ship we lose fighting a petty war between Bourne and Earth is a ship that can't protect our families on Solace or Longjump from the horrors of piracy.
units.italian: "È vero. Ma non dobbiamo perdere di vista i nostri obiettivi originali. La pirateria è una macchia sanguinosa sul Bordo Meridionale, e ogni nave che perdiamo combattendo una guerra meschina fra Bourne e la Terra è una nave che non può proteggere le nostre famiglie su Solace o Longjump dagli orrori della pirateria.

units.id: mission:FW Greenrock Lost Announcement|	"But now it looks like we'll have our hands full for the foreseeable future, and the pirates are going to make the most out of this for sure. Best to see this war over with."|868|0
units.english: "But now it looks like we'll have our hands full for the foreseeable future, and the pirates are going to make the most out of this for sure. Best to see this war over with."
units.italian: "Ma ora sembra che avremo le mani piene nel futuro prevedibile, e i pirati ne approfitteranno di sicuro. Meglio chiudere questa guerra."

units.id: mission:FW Greenrock Lost Announcement|	"I was at Shaula that day too, although it wasn't me who was commanding the ship. I thought my old captain did the right thing at that time, but he took the fall for it when the Senate began to butt their heads into our business. Even when Bourne decided overriding the orders of their most capable combat commander was a severe misjudgement, they go and disregard all our sacrifices in Shaula and throw Greenrock back to the jackals."|872|0
units.english: "I was at Shaula that day too, although it wasn't me who was commanding the ship. I thought my old captain did the right thing at that time, but he took the fall for it when the Senate began to butt their heads into our business. Even when Bourne decided overriding the orders of their most capable combat commander was a severe misjudgement, they go and disregard all our sacrifices in Shaula and throw Greenrock back to the jackals."
units.italian: "Ero anch'io a Shaula quel giorno, anche se non ero io al comando della nave. Pensavo che il mio vecchio capitano avesse fatto la cosa giusta allora, ma si è preso la colpa quando il Senato ha cominciato a ficcare il naso nei nostri affari. Anche dopo che Bourne ha deciso che scavalcare gli ordini del suo comandante più capace era un grave errore, passano sopra a tutti i nostri sacrifici a Shaula e ributtano Greenrock agli sciacalli."

units.id: mission:FW Greenrock Lost Announcement|	"Perhaps the Senate made a wise decision this time around. After all, Tomek's plan relied on the rest of the pirate worlds surrendering after Greenrock, and that didn't happen."|874|0
units.english: "Perhaps the Senate made a wise decision this time around. After all, Tomek's plan relied on the rest of the pirate worlds surrendering after Greenrock, and that didn't happen."
units.italian: "Forse questa volta il Senato ha preso una decisione saggia. Dopotutto il piano di Tomek si basava sull'idea che gli altri mondi pirata si arrendessero dopo Greenrock, e non è successo."

units.id: mission:FW Greenrock Lost Announcement|	"There's little we can do now. The challenge now is the Navy, not the pirates."|875|0
units.english: "There's little we can do now. The challenge now is the Navy, not the pirates."
units.italian: "Ora possiamo fare poco. La sfida adesso è la Marina, non i pirati."

units.id: mission:FW Greenrock Lost Announcement|	(Stay silent.)|877|0
units.english: (Stay silent.)
units.italian: (Resta in silenzio.)

units.id: mission:FW Greenrock Lost Announcement|	"You could make a case there. In the circumstances, it seemed like attacking Greenrock could have taken a lot of weight off our shoulders... but nonetheless, after the lull in action following Wei I think the Senate could have handled Greenrock far better."|879|0
units.english: "You could make a case there. In the circumstances, it seemed like attacking Greenrock could have taken a lot of weight off our shoulders... but nonetheless, after the lull in action following Wei I think the Senate could have handled Greenrock far better."
units.italian: "Puoi aver ragione. Nelle circostanze, sembrava che attaccare Greenrock potesse toglierci un bel peso dalle spalle... ma comunque, dopo la pausa nelle azioni che è seguita a Wei, credo che il Senato avrebbe potuto gestire Greenrock molto meglio."

units.id: mission:FW Greenrock Lost Announcement|	"That may be true, but I still believe it was a lost opportunity. We've had all this time since then to stabilize the situation in Shaula, yet the Senate has done nothing so they can prove the Greenrock occupation was a waste of resources."|883|0
units.english: "That may be true, but I still believe it was a lost opportunity. We've had all this time since then to stabilize the situation in Shaula, yet the Senate has done nothing so they can prove the Greenrock occupation was a waste of resources."
units.italian: "Può essere vero, ma continuo a credere che sia stata un'occasione persa. Abbiamo avuto tutto questo tempo da allora per stabilizzare la situazione a Shaula, eppure il Senato non ha fatto niente, così può dimostrare che l'occupazione di Greenrock è stato uno spreco di risorse."

units.id: mission:FW Greenrock Lost Announcement|	The militia captain continues, "It's really too bad, we really put the pirates on the wire when we went straight for their guts. But now it looks like we'll have our hands full for the foreseeable future, and the pirates are going to make the most out of this for sure."|886|0
units.english: The militia captain continues, "It's really too bad, we really put the pirates on the wire when we went straight for their guts. But now it looks like we'll have our hands full for the foreseeable future, and the pirates are going to make the most out of this for sure."
units.italian: Il capitano della milizia continua: "È davvero un peccato, avevamo davvero messo i pirati alle corde andando dritti al loro punto debole. Ma ora sembra che avremo le mani piene nel futuro prevedibile, e i pirati ne approfitteranno di sicuro."

units.id: mission:FW Greenrock Lost Announcement|	On that note, the two of you return to your duties.|888|0
units.english: On that note, the two of you return to your duties.
units.italian: Su questa nota, tornate entrambi ai vostri doveri.
